note: PLACEHOLDER map of a small cricket shop for tests and the demo. Step counts are placeholders for the owner's own measured counts (count them with the phone on your chest, at your walking pace, and replace). View texts are to be rewritten from real photos (shared/scripts/describe_shop_photos.py drafts them; a person checks them). 'front' is the direction of the zone's main photo.
